result.question: Why can't David go into battle?

readings.answer: So that the lamp of Israel may not be extinguished.
readings.support: so that the lamp of Israel may not be extinguished
David’s men swore to him | You must never again go out with us to battle

assessments.reason: The quoted reason “so that the lamp of Israel may not be extinguished” conveys preventing David’s death, matching the key’s “Risk of being killed.”

“David’s men swore to him… ‘You must never again go out…’” shows they forbade him; this identifies the immediate cause rather than the underlying reason, but it is a supported and plausible answer to why he can’t go.
